title: Change a person's liveness in an existing recipe 3 world
description: The body of POST /world/person-state. `status` is the liveness pair `terrain_liveness` already publishes and reads, not any block's own words: the producer finds which of heroes.people, heroes.dreads, npcs.people or villains.people the uid came from and writes that block's word -- `living`/`legend`, `alive`/`dead` or `living`/`fallen`. A caller never names the block and never sends one of those words. A uid that names a person in more than one block is refused rather than resolved by iteration order.

status.description: The published liveness vocabulary. Sending a block-local word such as `dead` or `fallen` is refused with both accepted values named.

reason.description: Why, in the caller's own words. Copied verbatim into history.operations, which is persisted, so it is bounded.
